texts.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们帝国面临的食物短缺问题正变得越来越严重。显然我们必须采取果断行动，否则短缺将在几个月内达到极限。
texts.en: The food shortages befalling our empire are becoming increasingly problematic. It is clear that we will have to take decisive action, otherwise the shortages will become terminal within a matter of months.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的克隆仓。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Clone Vats are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的生物反应堆。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Bio-Reactors are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

label.en: Everything is going according to plan.

note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们的食物债务已经无可救药。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
texts.en: Our food debt has become terminal. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

texts.zh: 我们的食物耗尽了。我们无法再为子个体或其他需要食物以维持运转的实体提供给养。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
texts.en: Our food has run out. We simply cannot provide any sustenance to the drones and other entities that require it to function. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to make large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution system.

texts.zh: 我们或许最珍视之物——自然资源的平衡——已经失守。我们的给养储备已经耗尽，导致整个食物链陷入困境。为了确保最大的生存机会，我们现在必须采取严厉的配给制和大规模的资源重新分配。
texts.en: That which we perhaps hold most precious - the balance of our natural resources - has failed. Our feed stocks have run out, causing distress throughout the food web. We must now resort to harsh rationing and large-scale reallocation of resources in order to ensure the greatest chance for survival.

summary.text:
# 食物短缺 / Food Shortages
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 资源赤字情境 resource-deficit situation
- 来源 Sources：`common/situations/02_deficit_situations.txt:815` · `events/situation_deficit_events.txt` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960-3020`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

资源赤字情境是引擎在该资源出现实际赤字时开始的（脚本中没有 start_situation 调用，仅在 `first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020` 等处按类型引用）；初始进度 15，共四个阶段（进度 25 / 50 / 75 / 100），每个阶段的惩罚递增：民用经济外交权重 −10%…−50%、人口组装减慢、舰船伤害与航速 −20%…−80%（非生物舰船）、机械帝国的科研劳动力 −33%…−75%（`02_deficit_situations.txt:1–16, 16–300`）。每月进度：赤字时增加“赤字进度值”，收入不为负时 −5，有库存缓冲时 −1；平民难度 ×0.1、学员难度 ×0.5（对非AI）。进度满即“破产”；情境被中止时按资源给予救助金。 / The engine starts a resource-deficit situation when the country has an actual deficit of that resource (no start_situation call exists in the shipped scripts; only type switches in first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020). It begins at progress 15 with four stages (25 / 50 / 75 / 100) whose penalties escalate: diplomatic economy weight −10%…−50%, slower pop assembly, ship damage and speed −20%…−80% (non-bio ships), machine research workforce −33%…−75%. Monthly progress rises with the deficit, falls by 5 when income is not negative and by 1 with a stockpile; civilian difficulty ×0.1, cadet ×0.5 for humans. Full progress is bankruptcy; aborting grants a bailout.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **情境“食物短缺”**：路线（approach）：无作为 / 投资农业者。/ Approaches: do nothing / invest in farmers.
2. **进入第四阶段（进度 ≥75）→ deficit.140 严重的食物短缺**：选项：关闭克隆池（非岩石体质且有克隆池）、关闭生物反应堆（有该建筑）等具体措施，以及借款/重新分配/按计划进行。 / Options include disabling the clone vats (non-lithoid empires with them), disabling the bio-reactors, plus borrowing, reallocating or carrying on.
3. **进度满 → deficit.145 破产！**：违约并大幅削减开支（意识集合则强制重新分配资源）。/ Progress complete → bankruptcy event deficit.145: the country defaults and makes sharp cutbacks.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

没有分叉结局：要么在进度满前把赤字扭转（情境失败 = 解除），要么破产。/ No branching ending: either the deficit is reversed before completion (the situation fails and ends) or bankruptcy follows.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

意识集合/机械帝国有不同文本与惩罚；破碎枷锁/分离主义者的相关支援会在阶段2–4提供少量资源。/ Gestalt and machine empires have different texts and penalties; separatist help (Fear of the Dark) adds small resources in stages 2–4.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：情境定义、阶段惩罚、进度公式、路线，以及阶段四和破产事件。/ Situation definition, stage penalties, progress formula, approaches and the stage-4 and bankruptcy events.
- 审阅改动 Changes：编译结构正确（情境 → 阶段四事件 → 破产事件）；补充了共同机制与本资源的路线。/ The compiled structure was correct; the shared mechanism and this resource’s approaches are documented.
- 不确定 Uncertain：情境的开始由引擎判定，脚本里看不到。 / The start of the situation is engine-side and not visible in the scripts.
